title: Apple CEO Tim Cook: The VICE News Tonight Interview (HBO)
summary: A 2018 VICE News Tonight interview with Apple CEO Tim Cook, in which he discusses privacy as a core company value, the Facebook breach, and Apple's iCloud arrangement in China.
why: Commenters cite it as a primary source for Cook's own words on Apple's privacy stance and on how iCloud data is handled in China.
